faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the PGIMER Project Technical Support-II recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the PGIMER Project Technical Support-II recruitment is 30-08-2026. Ensure your application is submitted well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Technical Support-II post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Three Years Graduate degree in life science from a recognized university along with two years of experience in public health or a PG degree in public health/environment.

faq.question: Q3. What is the maximum age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Project Technical Support-II post is 30 years. Age relaxation may be applicable as per government norms.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for the PGIMER Project Technical Support-II posts?
faq.answer: No, as per the provided information, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q5. What is the selection process for the Project Technical Support-II position?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Project Technical Support-II position will be based on an Interview.

faq.question: Q6. Is this a permanent or contractual job?
faq.answer: The job type for this recruitment is contractual. Candidates will be appointed on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q7. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Project Technical Support-II post in this recruitment drive.

faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the Important Links section of this article. It is recommended to read it thoroughly.

faq.answer: Applications need to be submitted online through the official PGIMER website or the direct apply link provided in the Important Links section before the last date.
